units: Targ. Is. XXIX, 4; a. e.—א׳ טמיא necromancy over bones, sculls, also for necromancer.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Deuteronomy 18:11">Targ. Y. I Deut. XVIII, 11</cite>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 59a:5">Ber. 59ᵃ</cite> <he>א׳ טמיא כדיב וכ׳</he> the necromancer is a liar (necromancy is false), and his (its) words are lies.

<cite ref="Shabbat 152b:13">Sabb. 152ᵇ</cite> bot. (of the woman of En-Dor, <cite ref="I Samuel 28:7">I Sam. XXVIII, 7</cite>). [<cite ref="Yevamot 103a:10">Yeb. 103ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="A02006"><he>בר א׳</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="A00116"><he>אַבְיוּ</he></cite>.]
